Third release candidate of nitpicker, a quality gate for code written by coding agents. It narrows each language to one allowed way of doing each thing and fails a change only for the problems it adds.

This is a pre-release: rules, messages and config keys can still change before 0.1.0. It is not on npm yet; install it from the tarball attached here.

## What's new since rc.2

- Monorepos and multi-project repositories: nitpicker finds the workspace packages and builds, checks the ones a change touches and their dependents, and reports per project with one exit code.
- `nitpicker --fix` fixes findings in every preset, with `--fix --dry-run` to preview.
- Labels on every rule and finding, and `--label` to focus a run on bugs, performance, tests or another kind.
- New rules for per-item I/O (N+1 queries and requests, including in reactive pipelines), transactions, soft-delete filters, HTTP value handling, untrimmed request text, field limits that disagree, `MAX_VALUE` overflows, and the real clock and network in Java and Kotlin tests. The logic rules decide more conditions and run on Go.
- Faster comparisons: analyzers and modules a change cannot affect are skipped.
- Fixes from running nitpicker on open-source TypeScript, React, Java and Spring Boot projects.

The full list follows.

## Presets

- `typescript` (default), with React rules
- `javascript`
- `python`
- `java`, with Spring rules, on Gradle and Maven
- `kotlin`, on Gradle and Maven
- `go`

## Install

Node.js 22.14 or newer and a Git repository. In your project's folder:

```sh
npm install --save-dev https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc.3/nitpicker-0.1.0-rc.3.tgz
npx nitpicker init
npx nitpicker
```

`init` detects the language, writes `nitpicker.config.json` and prints the peers to install and the agent skill for your preset.

To pin the exact file and check it, download it with its checksum and keep it in your repository:

```sh
gh release download v0.1.0-rc.3 --repo jhonDoe15/nitpicker --pattern 'nitpicker-*.tgz' --pattern SHA256SUMS --dir vendor
(cd vendor && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS && rm SHA256SUMS)
npm install --save-dev ./vendor/nitpicker-0.1.0-rc.3.tgz
```

## Agent skills

The tarball carries one skill per preset. Install the one for your project:

```sh
npx skills add ./node_modules/nitpicker --skill nitpicker-typescript
```

See the [README](https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/blob/v0.1.0-rc.3/README.md) and the [usage guide](https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/blob/v0.1.0-rc.3/docs/usage.md) for configuration, CI setup and adopting nitpicker on existing code.
